Instructions for Use
Device description: The Juniper Vena Cava Filter is a vena cava filter. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Information
The Juniper Vena Cava Filter is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 3 Tesla only when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum spatial gradient magnetic field of 25 T/m (2,500 Gauss/cm).
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- head transmit/receive coil only.
- Receive with the head transmit/receive coil.
- B1+rms must not exceed 1 μT; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 0.4 W/kg.
- Scan for up to 15 minutes.
- A cooling period of 10 minutes is required between scans.
Scan regions: Only head and lower extremity landmarks are permitted.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
